text_blocks.snippet: The most common side effects of Jardiance are urinary tract infections (UTIs) and genital yeast infections.
snippet_highlighted_words: urinary tract infections (UTIs) and genital yeast infections

list.snippet: Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Burning when you pee, cloudy urine, or an urgent need to go.
Genital yeast infections: Itching, redness, swelling, or unusual discharge in women and men.
Increased urination: Going to the bathroom more often because the medication removes extra sugar through your kidneys.
Dehydration: Feeling dizzy, faint, or lightheaded, especially when standing up.
Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A dangerous buildup of acid in the blood with symptoms like nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and trouble breathing.
Fournier’s gangrene: A rare but severe and painful bacterial infection of the tissue between the genitals and the anus.
Severe low blood sugar (hypoglycemia): Can happen if you take Jardiance with other diabetes medications like insulin or sulfonylureas.
Kidney problems: Sudden changes in kidney function or severe fluid loss.

text_blocks.snippet: You can learn more about safety details directly from the Jardiance Official Site.
